summary.text: Brent Andrews is a certified write-in unaffiliated candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine, listed by Spectrum News as living in York. No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia profile were found.

paragraphs.text: Listed as an unaffiliated candidate from York on the list of declared write-in candidates reported by Spectrum News; no further biographical information was found.
